title: Best AI Recruiting Tools 2026
summary: Top AI recruiting tools for frontline hiring. Compare features, use cases, and find the best fit for high-volume teams.
body_text: Recruiting has shifted from being recruiter-led and manual to automation-led and system-driven. At the same time, the recruiting environment has grown more complex. Employers now hire across multiple states with different wage laws, overtime rules, and background-check requirements. Leading organizations use AI beyond simple sourcing to streamline numerous HR processes. This includes automating onboarding, validating identity and work eligibility, ensuring real-time compliance, matching shifts, and managing high-volume workflows efficiently at scale. According to McKinsey, organizations that automate core HR and talent workflows can reduce hiring cycle times by 30-40%, a gap that has become decisive in competitive labor markets. These driving factors have led to a significant surge in the AI recruitment market, with projections indicating an increase from $660.23 million in 2025 to $1289.13 million by 2035 , according to MRFR analysis. North America remains the dominant market for these solutions, underscoring the region's high demand for advanced and innovative hiring technologies. Regions like the Asia-Pacific and the Middle East are experiencing rapid growth and increased investment. The increasing importance of AI in recruitment is evident in its growth, and the widespread use of this technology is anticipated to continue expanding significantly in the near future. This guide breaks down the top AI recruiting tools that actually work for frontline hiring, with a clear focus on speed, accessibility, compliance, and real-world outcomes. 1. Firstwork Firstwork is a next-generation HR platform explicitly designed for companies with dynamic workforce needs. It accelerates every stage of your workforce lifecycle from hiring, training, payroll, to analytics, all under one AI-powered roof. Unlike traditional ATS platforms that optimize for resumes and recruiters, Firstwork optimizes for speed, compliance, and candidate completion in high-volume environments. The platform automates hiring, onboarding, and verification workflows that vary by role, location, and regulation without requiring engineering support. Key Features Conversational AI screening: Replaces forms with guided, mobile-first conversations that adapt based on role requirements. Resume-free applications: Remove a central friction point for hourly workers, increasing application completion rates. Real-time document validation: Instantly flags invalid, expired, or unreadable documents, preventing downstream delays. No-code workflow orchestration: Hiring teams configure different flows for nurses, drivers, warehouse staff, or seasonal workers without engineering. Automated onboarding and re-verification: Handles credentials, compliance, and re-badging at scale. Why It Stands Out In real deployments, companies reduced onboarding cycles from days to minutes, cut candidate drop-off by more than 70%, and eliminated heavy manual reviews. It delivers measurable ROI quickly because it targets the operational bottlenecks where frontline hiring actually breaks. Check out the case study: How a staffing platform reduced its onboarding timeline from 10 days to 7 minutes using AI . Best Suited For Enterprises and platforms are hiring frontline workers at scale across retail, logistics, healthcare, hospitality, and staffing. Less relevant for organizations hiring exclusively white-collar or low-volume roles. 2. Paradox Paradox is a conversational AI platform designed to automate early-stage hiring interactions, primarily screening and scheduling for high-volume, hourly roles. It replaces delayed recruiter responses with instant, chat-based engagement, which is critical in frontline hiring where candidates often accept the first offer they hear back from. Key Features Chat-based applications: Candidates apply and answer screening questions via SMS or web chat rather than via forms. Automated screening logic: Filters candidates based on predefined criteria without recruiter involvement. Real-time interview scheduling: Connects directly to calendars to eliminate back-and-forth coordination. Multi-channel communication: Supports SMS and web-based conversations where frontline candidates already are. ATS integrations: Pushes candidate data into existing ATS systems. Why It Stands Out Speed is Paradox’s core strength. Research consistently shows that frontline candidates are far more likely to drop out if response times exceed 24-48 hours. Paradox reduces that gap to minutes, which directly improves interview show rates and hiring velocity. Best Suited For Large enterprises with standardized hourly roles and existing ATS infrastructure. Limited beyond pre-hire stages, onboarding, compliance, and credentialing typically require separate tools. 3. Hirevue Hirevue is an enterprise hiring platform focused on structured video interviews and AI-powered assessments. It was built to help organizations evaluate large candidate pools consistently when recruiter capacity is limited. Key Features On-demand video interviews: Candidates record their responses at their own pace, reducing scheduling friction. Structured interview frameworks: Ensure consistent evaluation across locations and hiring managers. AI-based assessments: Analyze responses for job-relevant competencies. Hiring analytics: Tracks funnel performance and interviewer effectiveness. ATS integrations: Fits into enterprise hiring ecosystems. Why It Stands Out Hirevue helps enterprises standardize hiring decisions across scale, which is valuable in regulated or brand-sensitive environments. It reduces interviewer load and shortens early-stage evaluation timelines. Best Suited For Enterprises hiring at scale with formal interview processes. Less effective for roles where speed, minimal friction, or resume-free hiring is a priority. 4. Humanly Humanly provides conversational AI that automates screening, scheduling, and candidate communication for hourly and frontline roles. It aims to keep candidates engaged while reducing recruiter workload. Key Features Conversational screening: Guides candidates through role-specific questions. Automated scheduling: Coordinates interviews without recruiter intervention. Candidate engagement workflows: Sends timely updates and reminders. DEI-focused tools: Designed to reduce bias in early screening. ATS integrations: Works alongside existing systems. Why It Stands Out Humanly emphasizes responsiveness and candidate experience, which directly impacts completion and show rates in hourly hiring. Best Suited For Mid-market companies are hiring frontline workers with relatively standard requirements. Limited flexibility for highly complex, role-specific compliance workflows. 5. Workable Workable is a broad ATS with AI features layered across sourcing, screening, and scheduling. It is designed to support a wide range of roles within a single system. Key Features AI-assisted sourcing: Recommends candidates from internal and external databases. Resume screening: Automates early filtering for roles where resumes are common. Interview scheduling: Reduces coordination overhead. Job board distribution: Expands reach with minimal effort. Hiring analytics: Tracks pipeline performance. Why It Stands Out Workable offers a balanced, easy-to-deploy ATS that works across frontline and white-collar roles without heavy configuration. Best Suited For SMBs with mixed hiring needs. Less optimized for mobile-first, high-volume frontline hiring at enterprise scale. 6. Greenhouse Greenhouse is a structured ATS focused on process consistency, compliance, and hiring analytics. Its AI capabilities support decision-making rather than replacing workflows. Key Features Structured interview kits: Ensure consistent evaluation criteria. Workflow automation: Standardizes hiring stages across teams. Compliance support: Helps organizations meet audit and reporting needs. Advanced reporting: Enables data-driven hiring decisions. Extensive integrations: Fits into mature HR tech stacks. Why It Stands Out Greenhouse enforces rigor and repeatability, which is critical in large, regulated organizations. Best Suited For Enterprises with mature TA teams. Not designed for resume-free or highly transactional frontline hiring. 7. Eightfold Eightfold is an AI talent intelligence platform that focuses on skills, potential, and long-term workforce planning rather than transactional hiring. Key Features Skills-based matching: Moves beyond resumes to identify transferable skills. Talent intelligence analytics: Provides visibility into workforce capabilities. Internal mobility tools: Supports redeployment and retention. Diversity insights: Helps identify bias and gaps. Enterprise integrations: Works across large HR ecosystems. Why It Stands Out Eightfold is built for strategic talent optimization, not just filling open roles. Best Suited For Large enterprises are planning workforce transformation. Less practical for urgent, high-volume frontline hiring. 8. HireEZ HireEZ is an AI-powered sourcing and engagement platform designed to help recruiters proactively find and engage candidates. Key Features AI-driven sourcing: Identifies candidates across platforms. Candidate engagement tools: Supports outreach and follow-ups. Talent CRM: Manages long-term candidate relationships. DEI-focused filters: Supports inclusive sourcing strategies. ATS integrations: Complements existing hiring systems. Why It Stands Out HireEZ strengthens the top of the funnel by expanding and diversifying talent pools. Best Suited For These tools primarily serve outbound recruiting teams, with limited functionality extending beyond initial candidate sourcing and engagement. 9. Recooty Recooty is a lightweight ATS built for simplicity and accessibility, with basic AI features to support small teams. Key Features AI resume matching: Automates early candidate filtering. Multilingual support: Enables global hiring. Job board integrations: Simplifies distribution. Simple pipelines: Easy for hiring managers to use. Collaboration tools: Supports small teams. Why It Stands Out Recooty lowers the barrier to entry for companies adopting recruiting software for the first time. Best Suited For Small businesses with straightforward hiring needs. Not suitable for high-volume or compliance-heavy frontline hiring. 10. Manatal Manatal is a cost-effective ATS offering AI-based candidate scoring and pipeline management. Key Features AI candidate scoring: Prioritizes applicants automatically. Visual pipelines: Simplifies tracking and movement. Social profile enrichment: Adds context to candidates. Collaboration features: Supports team-based hiring. ATS integrations: Connects with core HR tools. Why It Stands Out Manatal provides accessible AI functionality at a lower price point than most enterprise platforms. Best Suited For SMBs seeking affordable recruiting automation. Limited scalability and depth of automation for large frontline operations. How to Choose the Right AI Recruiting Tool for Frontline Hiring Most AI recruiting tools fail in frontline environments because they optimize for recruiters, not for candidates, speed, or operations. Use the criteria below to evaluate tools based on real frontline constraints, not feature lists. Final Takeaway Frontline hiring exposes the gaps in most AI recruiting tools. Speed, scale, and compliance don’t fail in theory; they fail in execution. Tools built for white-collar recruiting struggle when faced with: Resume-free candidates Seasonal hiring spikes Role- and location-specific requirements High drop-off sensitivity Firstwork stands out because it was built for these realities. It goes beyond screening and scheduling to automate the complete frontline hiring and onboarding lifecycle, delivering faster time-to-work, lower drop-offs, and measurable operational ROI. If your organization hires frontline workers at scale and needs results, not pilots, this is where AI actually delivers. Book a Demo with Firstwork

title: Best digital wallets in Colombia: which ones work and how to choose
summary: Discover the best digital wallets in Colombia, how they work, their differences, and which options are best for payments, savings, and international transfers.
body_text: In Colombia, digital wallets have become a key part of everyday finance. From online payments and international purchases to receiving money from abroad, Colombians increasingly rely on digital wallets to manage their money efficiently. In this guide, we review the best digital wallets available in Colombia, how they differ, and which factors matter most when choosing one. Why are digital wallets popular in Colombia? Several factors have driven adoption: Growth of digital payments and e-commerce Strong freelancer and remote work economy International remittances Demand for alternatives beyond traditional banking Digital wallets complement the local banking system while enabling global payments and access to digital dollars. Types of digital wallets used in Colombia Fiat digital wallets These wallets operate with traditional currencies and are usually linked to bank accounts or cards. Examples: Nequi Daviplata PayPal They are convenient for local payments, but often limited for international use. Crypto and Web3 wallets Web3 wallets allow users to store and transfer crypto assets directly on blockchains. Examples: MetaMask Trust Wallet They provide self-custody and global access, but require conversion steps to use funds locally. Hybrid wallets Hybrid wallets combine fiat usability with stablecoins and blockchain infrastructure. They allow users to save in digital dollars, send money globally, and reduce dependency on banks. Best digital wallets in Colombia Kontigo Kontigo is a hybrid wallet built around USDC, offering: Access to digital dollars Global transfers without banks Self-custody via MPC Lower exposure to local currency volatility Nequi A popular local wallet for everyday payments and transfers within Colombia. Daviplata Widely used for basic digital payments and government disbursements. PayPal Commonly used for international payments, though fees can be high. Binance Wallet Used mainly for crypto storage and P2P operations. MOVii Movii has a strong presence in the Colombian market, particularly among young people. Powwi Powwi is an app focused on fast payments and quick transactions. Tpaga TPaga is widely used by small businesses and independent workers. RappiPay RappiPay is integrated into the Rappi ecosystem and is popular among frequent users of the platform. Lulo Bank Lulo Bank is a full-service digital bank with built-in wallet features. Nu Colombia (Nubank) Although it is best known for its no–annual-fee credit card, Nu Colombia also functions as a digital wallet for payments and purchases. Ualá Ualá is a digital wallet that entered the Colombian market as part of the regional expansion of this Argentine fintech. Dale! (Aval Group) Dale! is the digital wallet of Grupo Aval, created to offer payments, transfers, top-ups, and purchases through a lightweight and easy-to-use platform. Mercado Pago Mercado Pago is very popular among users who shop online. PayPal PayPal is the global wallet used to receive international payments. Tuya Pay Tuya Pay is the digital wallet linked to Tuya, a company partnered with major retailers in Colombia. Wise Wise is one of the best platforms for international transfers. What should you consider when choosing a wallet? Local usability vs international reach Ability to hold dollars or stablecoins Fees and exchange rates Security and custody model Speed of transfers Why does Kontigo stand out from other digital wallets? While many Colombian wallets operate only within the country, Kontigo was built with a different vision: allowing your money to move with you, no matter where you are. For people who work remotely, receive payments from abroad, or want to manage their money in a more stable way, this app is a natural choice—aligned with a truly global financial lifestyle. Instead of being limited to local use, we focus on a modern, open model designed for people who want to manage their money without borders or dependence on traditional banks. It’s a tool to live, work, and grow with greater control and more possibilities. Download the app on iOS or Android and start moving your money without limits. Digital wallets and the future of money in Colombia Digital wallets continue to expand financial inclusion in Colombia, bridging local payments with global financial networks. Frequently Asked Questions Is it safe to use a digital wallet in Colombia? Yes, as long as the wallet is regulated or complies with strong security standards. Many operate under the supervision of Colombia’s Financial Superintendence or are partnered with a recognized financial institution. Which wallet allows you to send money abroad from Colombia? Wallets such as Kontigo, Wise, and PayPal allow international transfers from Colombia. Not all local wallets offer this feature, so it’s important to check whether they support international transfers, as well as their fees and processing times. What is the best wallet for freelancers in Colombia who get paid in U.S. dollars? Kontigo stands out for enabling users to operate with digital dollars (USDC) directly within the app, making it easier to receive payments and preserve the value of their money. Wise and PayPal are also common options, although they often involve higher fees or less flexible processes. Do digital wallets replace a bank account in Colombia? In some cases, yes—but it depends on the user. For basic payments, many people replace their bank account with wallets like Nequi or MOVii. However, for traditional financial products, a bank account is still necessary. Which wallets allow top-ups via PSE, Nequi, or DaviPlata? Kontigo, MOVii, Tpaga, Mercado Pago, RappiPay, and several Grupo Aval apps allow top-ups through popular systems such as PSE or wallets like Nequi and DaviPlata. Which wallets support USDC in Colombia? Kontigo is one of the most comprehensive options for managing digital dollars (USDC) in Colombia, allowing users to store, send, and use this stablecoin from a single app. Kontigo Team The Kontigo team creates content focused on digital money, stablecoins, cross-border payments, and financial inclusion.

This partnership with PTTEP in block SK408 marks a new milestone for TotalEnergies in Malaysia, following the acquisition of […]
body_text: Paris, December 16, 2025 – TotalEnergies has closed an agreement to divest to PTTEP an indirect interest of 9.998% in block SK408 in Malaysia. Further to this transaction, TotalEnergies keeps a 30.002% interest in block SK408. This partnership with PTTEP in block SK408 marks a new milestone for TotalEnergies in Malaysia, following the acquisition of SapuraOMV in December 2024 and the purchase of interests in multiple blocks from PETRONAS Carigali Sdn Bhd in June 2025. “With this transaction, TotalEnergies ensures efficient management of its portfolio in Malaysia, while strengthening ties with PTTEP, a long-standing partner of our Company. Together with PTTEP, we look forward to further contributing to the development of Malaysia's energy resources”, said Nicolas Terraz, President Exploration & Production at TotalEnergies . ***

body_text: PDF Version BEIJING, Dec. 11, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- KANZHUN LIMITED (“BOSS Zhipin” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: BZ; HKEX: 2076), a leading online recruitment platform in China, today announced that Mr. Phil Yu Zhang has resigned as an executive Director and Chief Financial Officer of the Company, each with effect from December 11, 2025 and has been appointed as the Chief Strategy Officer by the Company. Concurrently, our Vice President, Ms. Wenbei Wang has been appointed as the Company's Deputy Chief Financial Officer. Ms. Wang joined us in January 2021 and is responsible for investor relations. She has over 10 years of experience in the finance industry. Prior to joining us, Ms. Wang worked at the investment banking department of UBS from April 2012 to January 2021. Ms. Wang received her bachelor’s degree in engineering from Tsinghua University and her master’s degree in finance from Clark University. Mr. Peng Zhao, Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Kanzhun Limited, commented, “We extend our gratitude to Phil for his professional guidance and visionary perspective during his tenure as executive Director and Chief Financial Officer, which have significantly contributed to the Company's development. The Company holds unwavering confidence that Phil will continue to deliver substantial value in his role as Chief Strategy Officer, further driving the Company’s progress. We also believe that Ms. Wang will effectively perform her duties. The Company remains steadfast in its commitment to promoting more young talents into key management positions.” In addition, the Company is pleased to announce that with effect from December 11, 2025, Ms. Yang Mu has been appointed as an executive Director of the Company (the “ executive Director ”). Ms. Yang Mu, aged 46, is currently our Vice President of Human Resources. She has been responsible for overseeing the human resources functions of the Company since May 2016. Prior to joining us, Ms. Mu accumulated nearly a decade of management experience in human resources-related roles. She holds a bachelor’s degree from Peking University and a master’s degree from City University of Hong Kong. The Company is pleased to welcome Ms. Yang Mu to the Board and believes that Ms. Mu will continue to bring value to the Company. title: Court Provisionally Approves Settlement of Flux Power Holdings, Inc. Derivative Litigation
summary: SAN DIEGO, Dec. 18, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Flux Power Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLUX) provided the following notice of an Order from the…...
body_text: Court Provisionally Approves Settlement of Flux Power Holdings, Inc. Derivative Litigation December 18, 2025 9:00am EST Download as PDF SAN DIEGO, Dec. 18, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Flux Power Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLUX) provided the following notice of an Order from the United States District Court for the Southern District of California related to the proposed settlement of derivative action: IN THE UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE SOUTHERN DISTRICT OF CALIFORNIA RONALD PEARL, derivatively on behalf of FLUX POWER HOLDINGS, INC., Plaintiff, v. RONALD F. DUTT, CHARLES A. SCHEIWE, MICHAEL JOHNSON, MARK LEPOSKY, DALE T. ROBINETTE, LISA WALTERS-HOFFERT, AND CHEEMIN BO-LINN, Defendants, and FLUX POWER HOLDINGS, INC., Nominal Defendant. Case No.: 3:25-cv-00373-JO-DDL TO: ALL CURRENT RECORD HOLDERS AND BENEFICIAL OWNERS OF FLUX POWER HOLDINGS, INC. (“FLUX POWER” OR THE “COMPANY”) COMMON STOCK AS OF AUGUST 12, 2025 (“CURRENT FLUX POWER SHAREHOLDERS”) YOU ARE HEREBY NOTIFIED, pursuant to the December 8, 2025 Preliminary Approval Order entered in the above-captioned shareholder derivative action (the “Action”), that a Stipulation and Agreement of Settlement dated August 12, 2025 (the “Stipulation” or “Settlement”)1 has been entered to resolve the shareholder derivative claims pending on behalf of nominal defendant Flux Power in the United States District Court for the Southern District of California. The Action arises from allegations that the Individual Defendants breached their fiduciary duties as officers and directors of Flux Power by making false and/or misleading statements and/or failing to disclose that: (i) Flux Power’s financial statements from November 10, 2022 to the filing of the Complaint included, among other things, overstated inventory, gross profit, current assets, and total assets; (ii) Flux Power understated its cost of sales and net loss; (iii) as a result, Flux Power would need to restate its previously filed financial statements from November 10, 2022 to the filing of the Complaint; (iv) Flux Power understated its internal control weaknesses and/or stated that it had adequate internal controls when it did not; and (v) as a result, the Individual Defendants’ statements about its business, operations, and prospects, were materially false and misleading and/or lacked a reasonable basis. As a result of this alleged wrongdoing, the Action alleges the Company suffered damage. In connection with, and conditioned upon, the Settlement, Flux Power has agreed to implement and/or maintain corporate governance reforms, as defined and set forth in the Stipulation. The Parties believe that the Settlement is fair, reasonable, and in the best interests of the Company and its stockholders, and that the Settlement, including the Reforms, confers substantial benefits upon the Company and its stockholders. Defendants dispute the allegations in the Action and enter into the Stipulation and Settlement without in any way acknowledging any fault, liability, or wrongdoing of any kind. On April 2, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. PT, at the Edward J. Schwartz United States Courthouse, 221 West Broadway, San Diego, CA 92101, Courtroom 4C or via Zoom or some other video platform or telephonically, the Honorable Jinsook Ohta will hold a hearing (the “Settlement Hearing”) in the Action. The purpose of the Settlement Hearing is to determine, pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 23.1: (i) whether the terms of the Stipulation should be approved as fair, reasonable, and adequate; (ii) whether the notice that was issued fully satisfies the requirements of Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 23.1 and due process; (iii) whether to enter the proposed Order and Final Judgment in its entirety, as set forth in Exhibit D to the Stipulation; (iv) whether the Fee and Expense Amount for Plaintiff’s Counsel, as well as service award for Plaintiff of up to $2,000, to be paid from the Fee and Expense Amount, should be approved; and (v) such other matters as the Court may deem appropriate. The Court may: (i) approve the Settlement, with such modifications as may be agreed to by counsel for the Parties consistent with such Settlement, without further notice to Current Flux Power Stockholders; (ii) continue or adjourn the Settlement Hearing from time to time, by oral announcement at the hearing or at any adjournment thereof, without further notice to Current Flux Power Stockholders; and (iii) conduct the Settlement Hearing remotely without further notice to Current Flux Power Stockholders. If you intend to attend the Settlement Hearing, please consult the Court’s calendar and/or the website of Flux Power ( ir.fluxpower.com ) for any change in date, time or format of the Settlement Hearing. PLEASE READ THIS SUMMARY NOTICE CAREFULLY AND IN ITS ENTIRETY. IF YOU ARE A CURRENT FLUX POWER SHAREHOLDER, YOUR RIGHTS MAY BE AFFECTED BY THE SETTLEMENT OF THE ACTION . This is a summary notice only. For additional information about the claims asserted in the Action and the terms of the proposed Settlement, please refer to the documents filed with the Court in the Action, the Stipulation and its exhibits (they are filed as an exhibit to the Company’s Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission and available at www.sec.gov ), and the full-length Notice of Pendency and Proposed Settlement of Derivative Action (the “Notice”). The “Investor Relations” section of Flux Power’s website ( ir.fluxpower.com ) provides hyperlinks to the Notice and to the Stipulation and its exhibits. PLEASE DO NOT CONTACT THE COURT REGARDING THIS SUMMARY NOTICE . If you have any questions about matters in this Summary Notice you may contact Plaintiff’s Counsel at: Thomas J. McKenna, Gregory M. Egleston, Gainey McKenna & Egleston, 260 Madison Ave., 22nd Fl., New York, NY 10016, Tel: (212) 983-1300, email: tjmckenna@gme-law.com , gegleston@gme-law.com . If you are a Current Flux Power Shareholder, you will be bound by the Order and Final Judgment of the Court granting final approval of the Settlement and shall be deemed to have waived the right to object (including the right to appeal) and forever shall be barred, in this proceeding or in any other proceeding, from raising such objection. Any objections to the Settlement must be filed on or before March 12, 2026 , in accordance with the procedures set forth in the Notice. DATED: DECEMBER 8, 2025 HONORABLE JINSOOK OHTA U.S. DISTRICT COURT JUDGE 1 Except as otherwise defined herein, all capitalized terms shall have the same meanings as set forth in the Stipulation. title: OceanaGold Receives Permit Approval for the Waihi North Project
summary: /CNW/ - OceanaGold Corporation (TSX: OGC) (OTCQX: OCANF) ("OceanaGold" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that the Expert Panel appointed by the New...
body_text: VANCOUVER, BC , Dec. 18, 2025 /CNW/ - OceanaGold Corporation (TSX: OGC ) (OTCQX: OCANF) ("OceanaGold" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that the Expert Panel appointed by the New Zealand government to consider permitting of the Waihi North Project ("WNP") has released a final decision approving the project. OceanaGold is now officially permitted to develop and operate WNP, which includes the high-grade Wharekirauponga Underground mine ("WUG"), located ~10 kilometres ("km") North of the Company's Waihi operation in New Zealand. This permit approval includes the development of WUG and the associated surface infrastructure, expansion of the current processing plant and water treatment plant and construction of a new tailings storage facility. This marks a significant milestone for OceanaGold which has been many years in the making and sets the stage for transformative growth in New Zealand. The OceanaGold Board has approved the selection of the mining contractor for the tunnelling of the underground mine, plus the awarding of contracts for bulk earthworks at the Willows portal site and a power upgrade project. The mining contractor is expected to mobilize and begin tunnelling in the first half of 2026. The permit also allows an increase in the number of exploration drill pads and a doubling of the allowable drill rigs to six, which will allow the Company to further accelerate both definition and conversion drilling at Wharekirauponga in 2026 and beyond. Gerard Bond, President & CEO of OceanaGold, said "We are delighted to have received approval for our Waihi North Project, which allows access to one of the best undeveloped, high-grade orebodies in our industry. This is a major milestone for OceanaGold and for the Waihi operation and is a testament to our 35-year history of safe and responsible mining in New Zealand. We are grateful for the approval of this regionally significant project, for which we have done considerable work to ensure its compliance with all requirements of New Zealand's rigorous environmental laws. The development of WNP will provide meaningful gold production for years to come while bringing substantial investment, job creation, and economic and biodiversity benefits for the surrounding communities and New Zealand. We are in a strong net cash position and expect to internally fund WNP over the coming years, as well as progress our other organic growth opportunities while generating strong returns for shareholders." Waihi District Overview The town of Waihi on the North Island of New Zealand is located ~140 km southeast of Auckland and is the location of a gold district which has produced an estimated 8 million ounces of gold to date. The Waihi District comprises the Company's Waihi operation, which includes the currently producing Martha Underground mine, and WNP, which includes WUG. The Company owns a property (Willows), adjacent to and outside of the Coromandel Forest Park, that will host the main access portal to, and service the development of WUG. A 6.5 km twin incline will be built to access WUG from Willows, with initial plans for two ventilation shafts to be located in the Coromandel Forest Park. Development of WNP has the potential to create significant socio-economic contributions for the communities in the Waihi region and for New Zealand. This includes significant in-country investment and a substantial increase in direct and indirect employment opportunities, with the project having the potential to extend the life of the Waihi operation well into the future. OceanaGold operates to the highest environmental and social standards which has enabled it to run a successful and responsible mining business in New Zealand for over three decades and to meet the requirements of the Expert Panel's assessments. For a visual overview of the site and proposed project infrastructure, please see the accompanying video: https://vrify.com/meetings/recordings/60614a47-4b84-48a5-a077-27506b6a170e Waihi North Project Development Update The OceanaGold Board of Directors has approved the selection of the mining contractor to begin tunnelling for the underground mine. The Board has also approved the award of the bulk earthworks contract at the Willows portal site area and the contract for a power upgrade project. The mining contractor is expected to mobilize and begin tunnelling underground in the first half of 2026. Early-works, design and project activities continue to advance at WNP. The construction of the 5 km services trench to convey power, water and communications from the existing Waihi operations and to the Willows surface facilities area commenced in the third quarter of 2025. Civil works and fabrication are progressing well at the expanded water treatment plant site. Both projects are planned for completion by the second quarter of 2026, which will enable the decline and underground development work to commence thereafter. Gold production from WUG is expected to begin in 2032, with first stope ore in 2033. title: Are Mobile Game Controllers Worth It for Cross-Platform Players?
summary: Mobile controllers deliver cross-platform compatibility for PC, PS5, Xbox, and mobile gaming. Find out if universal controllers are worth the investment.
body_text: Gaming across multiple platforms has become the norm. Whether you're conquering mobile opponents during commutes, diving into PC matches at home, or relaxing with console games, seamless transitions between platforms define modern gaming. The question isn't whether cross-platform gaming matters, but whether investing in a dedicated mobile controller elevates your experience across all environments. The numbers speak volumes. 79% of gamers use mobile devices, with significant overlap toward PC (42%) and consoles (55%) , demonstrating most players aren't confined to single platforms anymore. The mobile gaming controller market reflects this demand, valued at $1.92 billion in 2023 and projected to reach $5.78 billion by 2032, expanding at 13.1% CAGR . Over 52% of controllers purchased last year featured cross-platform switching capabilities. What Makes Turtle Beach Controllers Cross-Platform Champions? Cross-platform compatibility means seamless device connections without complex setup. Turtle Beach's lineup addresses this through strategic design, prioritizing universal functionality while maintaining platform-specific optimizations. The Stealth Ultra Controller exemplifies this approach, delivering wireless freedom across PC, mobile, and console environments. Unlike single-ecosystem controllers, Turtle Beach maintains consistent button layouts and response characteristics across connected devices. Key features include wireless Bluetooth connectivity for universal pairing, low-latency performance ensuring competitive responsiveness, ergonomic design supporting extended sessions, and multi-device pairing eliminating repetitive setup. The Stealth Pivot Controller offers unique versatility, adapting to different scenarios. Whether streaming on mobile or engaging in intense PC battles, these controllers maintain precision and comfort, defining premium experiences. Why Cross-Platform Controllers Beat Single-Platform Solutions Traditional platform-specific controllers excel within ecosystems but create friction when switching devices. Universal controllers prioritize flexibility, allowing you to start mobile gaming during commutes and seamlessly continue on PC or console at home. 61% of global gamers adopted crossplay functionality in 2025, with 72% regularly engaging across multiple platforms . The Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded Wireless Controller delivers tournament-level performance across platforms without sacrificing convenience. The Cross-Platform Gaming Advantage Mobile controllers solve touchscreen precision limitations. While touchscreens work for casual experiences, they falter during competitive scenarios or extended sessions. Precision Control That Travels Physical buttons provide tactile feedback that touchscreens cannot replicate. Turtle Beach controllers register exact input timing, while analog sticks offer fine control for precise aiming and smooth movement. Games with crossplay show 25% higher player retention and 40% increased time spent across platforms . Seamless Platform Transitions 57% of consumers seek controllers functioning with both Android and iOS . Picture this: playing mobile games at lunch, continuing on PC after work, finishing on console at home. Cross-platform controllers maintain identical control schemes and muscle memory across environments. Many Turtle Beach controllers support multi-device pairing, enabling instant switching between paired devices. This feature alone justifies investment for regular platform-switchers. Enhanced Comfort for Marathon Sessions Extended mobile gaming strains hands when gripping phones directly. Controllers provide ergonomic grips designed for comfortable long-term use. The ultimate couch gaming setup becomes possible when controllers deliver consistent comfort regardless of gaming location. Navigating Cross-Platform Controller Limitations Compatibility Considerations Not every mobile game supports external controllers, particularly touchscreen-exclusive titles. Console compatibility presents additional complexity. While universal controllers work seamlessly with PC and mobile, PlayStation or Xbox connections often require specific models. Setup and Connectivity Challenges Bluetooth connectivity can introduce latency concerns, though modern controllers minimize this. For competitive gaming where milliseconds matter, wired connections offer more reliable performance. Investment Considerations Quality cross-platform controllers cost more than basic options. However, the investment makes sense for multi-platform gamers. One premium controller working everywhere costs less than separate controllers per device. Are Cross-Platform Controllers Worth Your Investment? This depends on gaming habits. Single-platform players might prefer platform-specific controllers. However, for regular cross-platform gaming, universal controllers provide unmatched flexibility. 87% of multiplayer gamers want more cross-platform titles, while 67% of developers shift toward cross-platform development . The industry moves toward greater platform flexibility, making universal controllers future-proof investments. Turtle Beach's controller lineup recognizes this trend. Whether choosing the versatile Stealth Pivot or high-performance Victrix Pro BFG, you're investing in hardware designed for gaming's connected future. Expanding Your Cross-Platform Setup Controllers represent one component of comprehensive setups. The Stealth 700 Gen 3 headset delivers consistent audio across platforms, while the Velocity One Race wheel extends capabilities to specialized genres. For competitive players, the Victrix Pro KO leverless fight stick represents cutting-edge competitive technology. Conclusion Cross-platform gaming represents interactive entertainment's future, demanding hardware matching software capabilities. Turtle Beach's controller lineup delivers precision, comfort, and connectivity that cross-platform gaming requires. FAQs Can I use the same Turtle Beach controller for mobile, PC, and console gaming? Most Turtle Beach universal controllers support mobile and PC seamlessly through Bluetooth or USB. Console compatibility varies by model. Controllers like the Stealth Ultra offer the broadest platform support. Do mobile games always work with external controllers? No. Most premium and competitive games include controller support, but casual games often rely exclusively on touchscreen input. Check game settings for compatibility. Is wireless latency a concern for competitive gaming? Modern Bluetooth controllers significantly reduced latency for most competitive scenarios. However, wired connections offer the lowest input lag for tournament play. How do I switch between devices? Most Turtle Beach universal controllers support multi-device pairing with dedicated switch buttons. Pair once per device, then quick-switch between paired devices. Are cross-platform controllers worth the higher prices? For multi-platform gaming, yes. A universal controller costs less than separate platform controllers while maintaining consistent layouts and muscle memory.

title: Top 10 Health Insurance Companies In Mumbai - 2026
summary: Compare Mumbai's best health insurers by claim settlement ratio, hospital network, and solvency. Data from IRDAI 2023-24 reports. Find coverage for Lilavati, Kokilaben, Hinduja hospitals.
body_text: Mumbai's health insurance market is crowded, confusing, and constantly changing. With 14% annual medical inflation and hospital bills at premium facilities like Lilavati or Kokilaben easily crossing ₹10 lakhs, choosing the wrong insurer isn't just inconvenient, it's expensive. Here's what actually matters: claim settlement ratios backed by IRDAI data, hospital networks that cover where you'll actually get treated, and financial stability that means your insurer will still be around when you need them. 1. Star Health and Allied Insurance India's largest standalone health insurer isn't just a marketing claim, it's backed by 14,000+ network hospitals and the most extensive branch network among health-focused insurers. The numbers: Claim settlement ratio: 82.31% (FY 2023-24) Solvency ratio: 2.21 Mumbai network: 274 hospitals Incurred claim ratio: 66.47% Market share: 5.26% Star Health's flagship Star Family Health Optima covers ₹1 lakh to ₹25 lakh with family floater options. The real differentiator? Specialized plans for diabetics (Star Diabetes Safe) and cardiac patients that actually cover pre-existing conditions without the usual runaround. Best for: Families needing specialized coverage for chronic conditions. 2. HDFC ERGO General Insurance Mumbai's strongest hospital network among private insurers: 343 cashless facilities including Lilavati, Nanavati Max, Breach Candy, and Holy Family. After acquiring Apollo Munich in 2020, HDFC ERGO built what might be the city's most comprehensive coverage map. The numbers: Claim settlement ratio: 97.94% (highest on this list) Solvency ratio: 1.8 Mumbai network: 343 hospitals National network: 12,000-16,000+ Health ICR: 80.98% The my:Optima Secure plan offers 4X coverage enhancement at no extra cost—the "secure benefit" activates from day one, unlike most enhancement plans that make you wait. Energy targets diabetics and hypertensive patients specifically, while Day2Day Care covers OPD expenses. The AI chatbot DIA handles basic queries, and WhatsApp support actually works. Best for: Anyone prioritizing claim approval rates and extensive hospital choice in Mumbai. 3. Care Health Insurance (formerly Religare Health) Care Health delivers a 92.77% settlement ratio plus the industry's best ICR at 57.69%. That low ICR means they're not bleeding money, which translates to sustainable premiums. The numbers: Claim settlement ratio: 92.77% Solvency ratio: 1.74 Mumbai network: 291 hospitals National network: 21,700-22,000+ (largest among standalone insurers) ICR: 57.69% Lives covered: 7+ crore The Care plan offers ₹3 lakh to ₹6 crore sum insured with global coverage. Care Supreme provides flexible benefits with advanced treatment coverage that doesn't nickel-and-dime you on consumables or procedures. Best for: Anyone who wants the largest hospital network and a proven claim settlement track record. 4. Niva Bupa Health Insurance (formerly Max Bupa) 30-minute cashless claim processing isn't a typo, Niva Bupa delivers on that promise. Backed by UK-based Bupa (63% stake) and fresh off a November 2024 IPO, they're India's third-largest standalone health insurer in retail. The numbers: Claim settlement ratio: 92%+ Solvency ratio: 2.55 (highest among standalone health insurers) Mumbai network: 235-238 hospitals Navi Mumbai network: 116 hospitals National network: 10,000-11,028 ReAssure 3.0 offers unlimited sum insured with pre-existing condition coverage from day one—a genuine rarity. Most insurers make you wait 3-4 years. Health Companion remains their bestselling comprehensive plan, while Aspire crossed ₹100 crore in gross written premium within three months of launch. Best for: Fast claim processing and wellness-focused policyholders who want rewards for healthy behavior. 5. Tata AIG General Insurance 100% claim settlement ratio in FY 2024 isn't just impressive—it's unprecedented. Combined with "100% Cashless Everywhere" allowing cashless treatment at any hospital in India , not just network facilities, Tata AIG fundamentally changed the game. The numbers: Claim settlement ratio: 100% Solvency ratio: 2.0 National network: 10,000-12,000+ Gross written premium: ₹13,606 crores (March 2024) Lives covered: 5+ crore Medicare Premier covers comprehensive care with optional riders: Mental Wellbeing, EmpowerHer (women's health), OPD Care, CanCare (cancer), and Flexi Shield. Health Supercharge provides 5X coverage enhancement for critical conditions. Initial cashless authorization in 1 hour, final discharge in 3 hours. The Tata Group's backing provides credibility, though the premium pricing reflects that brand value. Best for: Anyone who wants maximum claim approval certainty and cashless flexibility beyond network hospitals. 6. ICICI Lombard General Insurance India's largest private sector general insurer brings serious financial muscle: 8.55% market share and headquarters at Prabhadevi, near Siddhivinayak Temple. The joint venture between ICICI Bank (64%) and Canada's Fairfax Financial Holdings maintains a 2.5 solvency ratio. The numbers: Claim settlement ratio: 85% Solvency ratio: 2.5 Mumbai network: 158-254 hospitals National network: 5,380-6,500+ Policies issued: 36.2 million+ Elevate features unlimited claim restoration: critical for families facing multiple hospitalizations in one year. MaxProtect offers sum insured up to ₹1 crore in Classic and Premium variants. The unique Jumpstart cover reduces pre-existing disease waiting to just 30 days versus the standard 3 years. Mumbai hospital partnerships include Lilavati, Hinduja, Hiranandani, and Kokilaben. The IL TakeCare app facilitates 1-hour cashless approval. Best for: Banking relationship customers and anyone needing quick pre-existing condition coverage. 7. Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Mumbai's largest hospital network—988 facilities —combined with the industry's highest solvency ratio at 3.6 . That solvency number means Bajaj Allianz isn't going anywhere, which matters when you're buying 20-30 year renewable coverage. The numbers: Claim settlement ratio: 95.12% Solvency ratio: 3.6 (highest in industry) Mumbai network: 988 hospitals National network: 6,000-6,500+ Health ICR: 84.96% Health Guard serves as comprehensive base coverage, while HERizon Care (launched February 2025) is India's first women-specific holistic health product with Vita Shield and Cradle Care covers. Criti Care covers 43 critical illnesses up to ₹50 lakhs. Cashless claims process within 1 hour through the in-house Health Administration Team (HAT), and no TPA delays. The Insurance Wallet app enables direct claim settlement up to ₹20,000. Best for: Maximum hospital choice in Mumbai and unmatched financial stability. 8. Aditya Birla Health Insurance HealthReturns™ delivers up to 100% premium refund for maintaining healthy behaviors—the first wellness-based health insurance model in India. The joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital (45.89%) and South Africa's Momentum Group (44.08%) covers 22+ million lives. The numbers: Claim settlement ratio: ~90%+ Solvency ratio: 1.9 Mumbai network: 212-332 hospitals National network: 6,500+ ICR: 68.31% Activ One returns 100% of premiums for healthy policyholders meeting wellness targets. Activ Health Platinum covers chronic disease management from day one—diabetes, heart disease, and lung disease without waiting periods, which is genuinely rare. The Chronic Management Program provides health coaches, medication reminders, and diet plans through the ABHI mobile app, integrating fitness tracking and mental wellness helplines. Best for: Health-conscious individuals who want premium refunds for maintaining wellness targets. 9. ManipalCigna Health Insurance 96% cashless claim settlement within 2 hours —among the fastest in the industry. The combination of Manipal Group's Indian healthcare expertise with Cigna Corporation's 230+ years of global experience creates something genuinely different. The numbers: Claim settlement ratio: ~96% Solvency ratio: 1.56 Mumbai presence: Corporate office in Goregaon East National network: 8,500+ Lives covered: 19+ million ProHealth Prime offers comprehensive coverage including OPD, consumables, and women's health benefits. Sarvah (three variants: Pratham, Uttam, Param) provides infinite coverage for major illnesses. The unique Switch-off benefit and premium waiver features distinguish policies, along with up to 1000% cumulative bonus. Global treatment coverage extends to international hospitals—useful for anyone with international travel or treatment needs. Best for: Fast claim processing and international coverage needs. 10. SBI General Insurance 16,625+ hospital network nationally (expanding to 20,000+) leverages State Bank of India's massive branch infrastructure. With 17% growth to ₹12,731 crores GWP in FY 2023-24, SBI General ranks among the fastest-growing insurers. The numbers: Claim settlement ratio: 98% Solvency ratio: 2.0 National network: 16,625+ Customers served: 55.55 crore+ Distribution: 143 SBI General centers + thousands of SBI bank branches Arogya Supreme (Pro, Plus, Premium variants) offers 20 basic covers plus 8 optional add-ons. Health Alpha (launched October 2025) introduced India's first fully customizable DIY health plan with 50+ selectable covers. Super Health provides a 3X health multiplier for serious illnesses. The unique Claim Shield Protection covers consumables typically excluded from standard policies. Distribution through SBI's banking ecosystem enables seamless premium payments and policy management. Best for: Existing SBI banking customers and anyone prioritizing network size and accessibility. {{divider}} Understanding Mumbai's hospital coverage Major Mumbai hospitals maintain partnerships with most top insurers, though coverage depth varies. Lilavati Hospital, Hinduja Hospital, Breach Candy Hospital, Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital, Nanavati Max Hospital, and Sir HN Reliance Foundation Hospital accept cashless claims from all ten insurers listed above. Apollo Hospital (Navi Mumbai), Fortis Hospital (Mulund), Asian Heart Institute, Bombay Hospital, SevenHills Hospital, and Wockhardt Hospital also maintain broad network agreements across multiple insurers. Tata Memorial Hospital, as a specialized cancer center, maintains limited direct insurance tie-ups—verify specific policy coverage before treatment. {{divider}} What changed in 2024-2025 (and why it matters) IRDAI's Master Circular on Health Insurance (May 2024) introduced consumer-friendly reforms now benefiting Mumbai residents: Pre-existing disease waiting periods dropped from 4 to 3 years , and insurers can no longer refuse coverage for severe conditions including cancer, heart disease, renal failure, and AIDS. 1-hour cashless authorization became mandatory , transforming hospital admission experiences. Industry-wide cashless delays dropped from 1.87% to 0.39% by H1 2025-26. The 30-day free look period provides uniform policy review rights, and the moratorium period reduction from 8 to 5 years means claims cannot be rejected for non-disclosure (except fraud) after five years of continuous coverage. Mental health insurance claims surged 41% year-over-year in 2025, prompting expanded coverage options from multiple insurers. Women-specific products like Bajaj Allianz HERizon Care address gender-specific health needs increasingly demanded by Mumbai's working women population. {{divider}} Which is the best health insurance in Mumbai for corporates? The answer depends on what you're optimizing for, but it's not just about picking an insurer anymore. Corporate health insurance has evolved from "just get them covered" to strategic workforce management that directly impacts retention, productivity, and your bottom line. The corporate equation is different from retail When you're covering 50+ employees in Mumbai, the math changes completely. Group health insurance premiums are typically 15-25% lower than individual policies for the same coverage. You get negotiating leverage on sum insured, room rent caps, and sub-limits. More importantly, you can bundle wellness programs and preventive care that reduce claims over time. Group health insurance represents 50.5% of India's total health insurance market , covering approximately 250 million lives through corporate policies. That's not because companies are generous—it's because comprehensive benefits reduce attrition by 35% and every ₹1 spent on prevention saves ₹133 in absenteeism costs. {{divider}} What Mumbai corporates actually need Coverage baseline: ₹5-10 lakhs was adequate in 2020. Not anymore. With procedures at Hinduja Hospital costing ₹2-3 lakhs for basic angioplasty and comprehensive cancer treatment exceeding ₹15 lakhs, you need ₹10-20 lakhs minimum for individual coverage and ₹20-30 lakhs for family floaters. Hospital network depth: Your employees won't care about 10,000 hospitals nationally if none are near their homes in Andheri or Borivali. Prioritize insurers with 250+ Mumbai hospitals, including the facilities your employees actually use: Lilavati, Hinduja, Nanavati, Kokilaben, and local nursing homes in suburban areas. Claim settlement infrastructure: The 1-hour cashless authorization mandate (IRDAI 2024) is now standard, but implementation varies wildly. Some insurers hit that target 99% of the time. Others... not so much. Digital experience: 74% of employees now expect mental health services, and 84% want continued telemedicine access post-pandemic. Your insurer needs mobile apps that actually work, unlimited doctor consultations, and 24/7 medical advisor access—not PDFs and phone trees. Top corporate health insurance picks for Mumbai For companies prioritizing claim certainty: HDFC ERGO (97.94% settlement) or Tata AIG (100% settlement) minimize the HR escalations when employees face claim rejections. Their extensive Mumbai networks (343 and 10,000+ hospitals respectively) cover every major facility. For startups and SMEs (50-500 employees): Niva Bupa combines competitive group pricing with 30-minute claim processing and strong digital infrastructure. Their 235 Mumbai hospitals cover most employee needs without premium pricing. For large enterprises (500+ employees): Care Health's 21,700+ national network and 57.69% ICR (lowest among standalone insurers) create sustainable long-term costs. Their corporate wellness integration and 7+ crore lives covered demonstrate scale experience. For companies serious about prevention: This is where most insurers offer basic wellness as an add-on, but prevention needs to be structural, not decorative. You need 24/7 medical advisor access, unlimited doctor consultations across specialties, proactive health programs for diabetes and hypertension, and digital infrastructure that employees actually use, not annual health camps they ignore. The data is clear: organizations with comprehensive wellness programs see 35% lower attrition and measurably better health outcomes. But most corporate insurance stops at claim processing, leaving prevention as HR's problem. {{divider}} The insurance + wellness model Here's what's changing the corporate benefits landscape in Mumbai: instead of choosing between insurance and wellness, leading companies are integrating both. Group health insurance handles protection (hospitalization, claims, cashless treatment). Healthcare and wellness offerings handle prevention (doctor consultations, health screening, chronic disease management, mental health support). The business case is straightforward. Medical inflation runs at 14% annually in India—the highest in Asia. Premiums jumped 25-50% in 2024 alone. Without prevention, you're in a loop: higher claims → higher premiums → budget pressure → coverage cuts → worse health outcomes → even higher claims. Prevention breaks that cycle. Companies investing in proactive health see claims reduce, premiums stabilize, and employee engagement increase. It's the only sustainable path when hospital bills at Mumbai's premium facilities routinely exceed ₹10 lakhs. {{divider}} What to actually look for in corporate coverage 1. Sum insured flexibility: Standardized coverage doesn't work. Your C-suite needs ₹25-50 lakhs. Junior employees need ₹5-10 lakhs. Middle management falls between. Look for grade-based sum insured options, not one-size-fits-all. 2. Pre-existing disease handling: The waiting period dropped from 4 to 3 years (IRDAI 2024), but some insurers, like ICICI Lombard's Jumpstart reduce it to just 30 days. For companies with older employees, this matters enormously. 3. Parental coverage: 60% of Indian employees financially support parents. Including parent coverage (with reasonable premiums) becomes a major retention tool, especially in Mumbai's expensive healthcare market. 4. Mental health parity: Mental health claims surged 41% year-over-year in 2025. Your policy needs EAP integration, counseling coverage, and psychiatric treatment without sub-limits or stigma. 5. OPD benefits: Most policies cover only hospitalization. But employees need coverage for doctor visits, diagnostics, medicines, and preventive care. OPD benefits reduce out-of-pocket expenses and encourage early intervention. 6. Wellness infrastructure: Annual health camps are performative. You need ongoing engagement: bi-weekly wellness programs, digital health tracking, chronic disease management, nutrition counseling, and fitness support. Loop partners see 70% employee engagement in wellness programs through this online-offline approach. 7. Claims support: The difference between good and great insurance shows up at 2 AM when an employee's parent is admitted. Do you have 24/7 claims advisors? Dedicated support for complex claims? On-ground assistance in Mumbai when needed? {{divider}} The ROI of getting this right Mumbai's corporate talent market is brutal. Losing a senior engineer costs 1.5-2x their annual salary in recruitment, training, and productivity loss. Comprehensive health benefits reduce attrition by 35%. Absenteeism from preventable chronic disease costs companies dearly. ASSOCHAM data shows wellness programs could save Indian corporations up to $20 billion by reducing diabetes, hypertension, and stress-related illness. Every rupee spent on prevention saves ₹133 in absenteeism costs. Premium stability matters. Companies with strong prevention programs see claims reduce 15-20% over 3-5 years, creating negotiating leverage for renewal premiums instead of accepting automatic 25-50% increases. {{divider}} Bottom line for Mumbai corporates The "best" corporate health insurance for Mumbai isn't a single insurer—it's the right combination of: Strong insurer with proven claim settlement (HDFC ERGO, Tata AIG, Care Health, Niva Bupa) Adequate coverage (₹10-20 lakhs minimum, ₹20-30 lakhs for family floaters) Comprehensive hospital network (250+ Mumbai facilities, including premium hospitals) Digital infrastructure that employees actually use Wellness integration that prevents claims before they happen Support infrastructure for seamless claims experience If you're just comparing premium costs, you're optimizing for the wrong metric. The cheapest policy becomes expensive when employees leave, claims get rejected, or premiums spike 50% at renewal because your claims ratio is terrible. {{divider}} Corporates and health insurance in Mumbai Choosing the right health insurance isn't just about protecting employees, it's about attracting talent, reducing attrition, controlling healthcare costs, and building a culture where people actually want to work. In Mumbai's competitive market, comprehensive benefits aren't optional anymore. But here's the challenge: picking insurance for yourself is hard enough. Picking it for 50, 500, or 5,000 employees? That's exponentially more complex. Every company has different priorities. Some need shorter waiting periods for pre-existing conditions because their workforce skews older. Others prioritize parental coverage because 60% of Indian employees financially support parents. Startups need cost-effective plans that don't compromise on network hospitals. Large enterprises need seamless claims support across Mumbai and beyond. There's no single "best" insurer for every company, which is exactly why most HR teams struggle. You're comparing claim settlement ratios, hospital networks, premium structures, waiting periods, sub-limits, and wellness add-ons across 10+ insurers. Then negotiating group rates, coordinating with TPAs, managing enrollment, and handling claim escalations when employees actually need help. Which is where Loop comes in. Loop works as your health assurance partner , not just an insurance broker. We help companies find the right insurance provider that actually serves their specific needs—whether that's maximizing hospital coverage in Andheri and Borivali, minimizing waiting periods for chronic conditions, or structuring grade-based sum insured that makes sense for your organization. But insurance alone doesn't solve the problem. Remember that loop we discussed earlier? Claims increase → premiums spike 25-50% → budget pressure → coverage cuts → worse health outcomes → even higher claims. Loop breaks that cycle by functioning as a health and wellness partner for your company. With Loop, your teams get 24/7 medical advisor access, unlimited doctor consultations across specialties, proactive health programs for diabetes and hypertension, and wellness initiatives that they engage with + 70% engagement rates versus the 10-15% you see with annual health camps. The result? Companies working with Loop see claims reduce over time, which translates directly to better renewal premiums. Prevention isn't just good for employee health, it's good for your bottom line too. Mumbai's workforce deserves better than insurance that only works when you're already sick. While there are good individual insurance options available, what was missing was an intermediary that ensures companies choose the best when it comes to employee health, combining the right insurance protection with preventive care that actually keeps people healthy. Because at the end of the day, healthy employees aren't just a nice-to-have. They're your competitive advantage.

title: CNX Mentorship Academy Students Discover Career Opportunities at Dura-Bond Pipe
body_text: Appalachia First Mentorship Academy CNX Mentorship Academy Students Discover Career Opportunities at Dura-Bond Pipe December 3, 2025 By Positive Energy Hub Staff This fall, CNX Mentorship Academy students visited Dura-Bond Pipe's McKeesport facility for demonstrations and hands-on exposure to the rewarding careers available in energy and manufacturing in southwest Pennsylvania. The visit brought together industry leaders, elected officials, and mentors who shared a common vision: connecting Appalachia's next generation with the good-paying, family-sustaining jobs that are the bedrock of our communities. A Partnership Built on Shared Values CNX is grateful to Dura-Bond Pipe for opening their doors and exemplifying the kind of partnership that has grown the Mentorship Academy to what it is today. Additionally, CNX thanks the elected leaders who attended. Lieutenant Governor Austin Davis on Twitter / X In my home town of McKeesport, students are seeing new opportunities to expand their skills, get career advice, and connect with future employers. With targeted state investments, programs like these are growing in Pennsylvania, giving our students and young adults the chance… pic.twitter.com/tl0j0pPiRK— Lieutenant Governor Austin Davis (@LGAustinDavis) October 24, 2025 Twitter Lt. Governor Austin Davis, State Senator Nick Pisciottano, Representative Dan Goughnour, and Representative John Inglis brought not just their presence, but their advocacy and support for these vital career pathways. When business leaders and public officials stand together, they send a powerful message to students: your future is here, and your community believes in you. Senator Nick Pisciottano on Twitter / X Last week I participated in @CNXTweets’s Mentorship Academy Day with @LGAustinDavis, @RepGoughnour & @RepInglis at Dura-Bond Pipe in McKeesport. The Academy exposes students to good energy & manufacturing careers in our region - most of which do not require a college degree. pic.twitter.com/FY6isiEbtN— Senator Nick Pisciottano (@SenPisciottano) October 28, 2025 Twitter Inspiration Through Real-World Experience For many of students, this was their first opportunity to see a manufacturing facility in action—to meet the people doing the work, understand the skills required, and imagine themselves in these roles. That's the power of the Mentorship Academy. It transforms abstract careers into concrete realities. The students left Dura-Bond energized by what they'd learned and inspired by the prospects ahead. More importantly, they left knowing that their region is investing in them. Investing in Our Future Partnerships like this with Dura-Bond, combined with the commitment of elected officials like those who attended, are a reminder of why the Mentorship Academy matters so much. The Academy is not just introducing students to jobs—it’s building a pathway to prosperity that keeps talent, energy, and opportunity right here in Appalachia. This is what Appalachia First looks like in action. You may also like... CNX Hosts Intro to Energy 2025 150+ Students, 1 Goal: Inspiring Tomorrow's Workforce Positive Energy Hub
